_help: Cairo's crowd (scripts/crowd.gd). density: people per graphics quality. models: their looks (Characters.DIR paths; image-to-3d's townsfolk replace the stand-ins here). waypoints: street points walkers path between over the navmesh (none within keep_clear m of a door, an action spot or a standing NPC). stalls: [x, z, facing yaw] where a customer stands at a bazaar table. seats: [x, z, facing yaw, stool] where someone sits (stool: put a stool there, for the tavern tables). beasts: donkeys walking a street [[x, z], [x, z]]. Positions are from scripts/acts/cairo.gd's layout.
